title: Superman Family #204 DC Dec 1980 Dollar Comic Supergirl Lois Lane Jimmy Olsen
condition_description: Bright cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. See photos.
description:
The Superman Family #204 (December 1980), DC Comics - Dollar Comic, 5 all-new stories: Supergirl, Lois Lane, Jimmy Olsen, Mr. and Mrs. Superman and Clark Kent. Cover by Ross Andru and Dick Giordano. Newsstand edition, $1.00 cover price.

Back cover: Daisy 840 BB gun ad.

Condition: bright cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
